objectives.statement: Identify the main word and meaning direction in complex Bokmål compounds.
Recognize and choose common linking elements in longer compounds.
Use common prefixes and suffixes to form abstract nouns and participant nouns.
Diagnose and repair word-formation errors in formal Bokmål.

notes: Must teach advanced Bokmål word formation: analysing and producing complex compounds and derivations, including linking elements and less transparent forms. Build on compound_nouns and word_formation; defer fixed idioms to fixed_expressions_idioms.
